note: Published tuition and fees used for the savings estimate. One rate per college: undergraduate, Louisiana resident. perCreditHour is the college's published tuition and fees for a full-time semester load of 15 credit hours, divided by 15, so the estimate reflects what a full-time student actually pays per hour of degree credit. A college with no verified published rate has no entry, and no savings figure is shown for it. Rates are re-verified when a college publishes a new schedule.
